simplified_text:
If someone intentionally or recklessly does something that is against the law and gives a reason for someone to riot, they will be punished. 

This can happen in two ways. First, if the riot actually happens because of the provocation, the person who gave the provocation will be punished with up to one year in prison, or a fine, or both. 

Second, if the riot does not happen, the person who gave the provocation will still be punished with up to six months in prison, or a fine, or both.

claims.claim_text: If someone intentionally or recklessly does something that is against the law and gives a reason for someone to riot, they will be punished.
claims.evidence_text: Whoever maliciously or wantonly, by doing anything which is illegal, gives provocation to any person intending or knowing it to be likely that such provocation, will cause the offence of rioting to be committed, shall, if the offence of rioting be committed in consequence of such provocation, be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both;
